limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Ren and Wang's H=2Z parity construction, the foundational ideal-approximation framework, and later positive and negative results on object ideals are prior work. The novelty claim is restricted to the arbitrary Euler-subgroup family, uniform Euler-zero stabilization, the two Z/H obstruction classes and completeness criterion, universal simultaneous witness, residue-pair realization, and the sharp total-Betti modulus threshold. Targeted searches did not locate an equivalent formulation, but the parity source is a recent first version and an equivalent subgroup observation could exist under different terminology.
record_title: Euler-subgroup cuts separate ideal and object cotorsion completeness
